senses.gloss: क्रैडिन॑ mf(ई)n. (fr. क्रीडि॑न्), belonging to the Maruts or winds, ŚBr. xi, 5, 2, 4; ĀśvŚr. ix, 2; ŚāṅkhŚr. xiv, 10, 7; KātyŚr. ii and iv, Sch.
क्रैडिनीया f. scil. इष्टि, the Iṣṭi or sacrificial oblation sacred to the Maruts, KātyŚr. ii and iv, Sch.
क्रै॑व्य m. a king of the Krivis, ŚBr. xiii, 5, 4, 7.
